exposure: time between birth and first corrective surgery
Time between birth and first corrective surgery
cohort: Neonates with gastroschisis who underwent surgical correction from 2010 to 2015
finding: Neonatal mortality in gastroschisis was high (51.2%) and was associated with fewer prenatal visits, delayed prenatal diagnosis, low birth weight, intestinal injury, sepsis, and surgery performed after more than 4 hours of life.
mod_finding: The type of delivery was not associated with increased neonatal mortality.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 2159g in those who died postoperatively vs. 2444g in those who were discharged
